recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration work out a strategy to ensure that the elements and tools of the standardized funding model are invariably used for first-year budget formulation to ensure that newly mandated missions are able to gain access to the necessary resources without any delay and rapidly mobilize to initiate operational implementation.

history.administration_response: Subsequent to its application for the first full year budget for UNMISS, and in line with the request of the General Assembly in its resolution 66/243, the Secretariat conducted a lessons-learned review of the standard funding model to determine whether the model had achieved its primary objectives of fiscal discipline, streamlined process, legislative transparency and flexibility. In its resolution 69/307, the Assembly upheld the recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (see A/69/874) against further development of the standard funding model on the basis that it lacks flexibility, and against further refinements to the model
history.board_assessment: The recommendation has been overtaken by events
